_doc: Tonic's Second Wind (Project Redmond R3, gadgets/R3_OPERATORS.md §2; the medic's updated version, Ulo's pick; our numbers, the official page gives none): his ability, the wrist monitor in his slot 2 (Z), held up like a tablet. Every operator on his team wears a patch. With the monitor up, the wheel picks a teammate (or himself, or Auto: a downed teammate first, else the most hurt) and Fire sets the picked one's patch off, from anywhere (net/room.ts patches): on a body on its feet it heals `patch.heal` over `patch.healS` (up to its most); on a downed one it stops the bleeding and gets him up `patch.reviveS` later with `patch.reviveHp`. One teammate's patch at a time; his own apart from that, and when he's down the ability key sets his own off. `count` patches a round in all. Electronic: an EMP on Tonic stops the monitor; one on a patched body stops its patch.
name: Second Wind
